selectedSlice.scope: Only the existing teacher-facing settings confirmation/reopen interaction and its perceptible outcome states; no navigation, lesson workflow, calendar, curriculum intake, database contract or product-wide shell migration.
selectionRationale: Existing runtime evidence already demonstrates explicit confirmation actions, reducing semantic invention.
The surface is bounded and teacher-facing, so human authority can be tested directly.
It can consume the qualified REVIEW_DECIDE_CONFIRM, STATUS_MESSAGE, LOADING_PENDING_PROGRESS and ERROR_RECOVERY semantics without requiring ecosystem-wide replacement.
The slice does not require an offline/degraded continuity claim; OFFLINE_DEGRADED therefore remains outside the authorization path for this slice.
Rollback can be isolated to the settings interaction without changing curriculum authority or lesson preparation contracts.

explicitlyOutOfScope: database schema or persistence contract changes

mustPreserve: teacher remains the explicit decision authority
existing Docente OS information architecture and local product identity
confirmation is never inferred from navigation, timeout or default selection
feedback is perceptible and attributable to the action just taken
partial/unqualified capabilities are not presented as ecosystem-wide guarantees
forbidden: copying Arena or Atlas visual identity into Docente OS

allowed: adapter or wrapper around the existing settings confirmation interaction
qualified status/pending/error semantics limited to the selected surface
local styling through Docente OS PVIP/token mapping
surface-specific automated tests and accessibility checks
forbidden: broad refactor justified only by design-system adoption

functional: reopen/reverse transition remains explicit where currently supported
duplicate consequential activation is prevented or rendered harmless for this surface
stale/conflict conditions do not silently overwrite a newer state
perceptibility: pending state is visible when an asynchronous transition is in progress
success and failure are announced perceptibly
focus is restored or advanced predictably after modal/confirmation completion
accessibilityResponsive: screen-reader semantics for decision, pending and outcome states
200 percent zoom/reflow without horizontal interaction loss
smartphone viewport without clipped primary actions
privacy: no new server-side teacher profile dependency

successCriteria: qualified pattern semantics are traceable to the Stage A.2 contracts
no regression in existing settings confirmation/reopen behavior
human verification passes on desktop and smartphone
failureCriteria: loss of keyboard or screen-reader operability
unexpected change outside the selected surface

rollback.rule: The Stage B implementation must be independently revertible without reverting Stage A governance artifacts or unrelated Docente OS changes.
rollback.trigger: Any acceptance failure or scope escape blocks adoption and requires rollback before further expansion.

offlineDecision.rule: No offline/degraded resilience claim may be introduced by this slice. If implementation discovers such a dependency, Stage B authorization stops and TRAMA.OFFLINE_DEGRADED must be qualified first.

nextGates: human approval of exact plan head
separate Stage B runtime implementation branch in Docente OS
